hooks.command: jq -r 'if ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("git push")) then {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"QA RUN NOTE — MANDATORY after any git push. IF the repo has a pm-config.md that names Compass (Compass project): the QA report goes in COMPASS, not the vault — find or create the Compass Task for this work, write the report as a Compass Doc (write_doc, kind QA_REPORT, path `QA Reports/<YYYY-MM-DD> <title>`), link it to the Task (link_task DOC + add_comment TASK), then write the gate receipt ~/.claude/qa-gates/<branch with / and spaces as __>.gate containing `QA-GATE: PASS branch=<branch> task=TASK-<n> report=<doc url>`. Screenshots stay in the vault under Attachments/QA/<Project>/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>/ and are referenced from the Compass doc.
